picks.editorial_note: Nebraska-Lincoln will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a five-year, $24.5M NSF national cyberinfrastructure project — a major federal investment and a rare lead role for a non-flagship-tier institution in AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins won the 2026 Pritzker Prize for AI in Science for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, validating deep learning as a tool that has already produced real drug candidates against resistant bacteria.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge team used AI-guided design to create a broad-spectrum bird flu vaccine with complete protection against diverse variants in animal trials, a concrete step toward pandemic-preparedness tools built on machine learning.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: Boston University joined a $39.5M ARPA-H-funded consortium with Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell to build AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke intervention, a significant federal bet on AI-driven medical robotics.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC signed a strategic framework to advance AI and financial innovation through a new AI & Emerging Technology Institute, extending a long-running academia-finance partnership into formal institutional backing.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The DOE released 'Genesis Agent Skills' with Fermilab-developed agentic AI tooling for scientific machine learning, a notable step toward shared AI infrastructure across the national lab system under the Genesis Mission.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team will combine satellite imaging, health data, and AI to study environmental contributors to Alzheimer's and dementia, a large-scale application of AI to a major public health question.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: ASU's Yalin Wang received $3.2M in NIH funding to use deep learning on retinal imaging and blood biomarkers to screen for preclinical Alzheimer's, a promising low-cost early-detection approach backed by substantial federal funding.
picks.title: What the eye may reveal about Alzheimer’s

picks.editorial_note: ANU received Google.org funding to modernize its SPEC fusion simulation tool with AI and advanced computing, pairing a major tech company's resources with fusion energy research in a space with high long-term payoff.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from purely synthetic, self-generated data rather than real-world data, a result with broad implications for how future models could be trained.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It
